items.caption: Saturn's moon Enceladus sprays ice and water vapour into space: Cassini counted 101 geysers near its south pole, and a salty ocean lies under the ice. Most falls back as snow; some forms one of Saturn's rings. Save it! Images: Cassini, NASA/JPL/SSI.
